result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: Central IRT with a permuted-block schedule (sequence + concealment).

witnesses.span: Patients who meet all eligibility criteria will be randomized centrally by an Interactive Response Technology (IRT) using a permuted-block randomization schedule

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Identically appearing blinded syringes; efficacy analysis in the ITT population.

witnesses.span: The trial medications and placebo were provided in iden- tically appearing prefilled syringes in a blinded manner.
The efficacy analysis population will be the ITT population.

D3_missing_outcome_data.why: Vital status known for 99.9%; primary-outcome status known for 96.7% (the 3.3% gap is noted for the reviewer).

witnesses.span: status with respect to the primary outcome was known for 3941 of the 4076 participants (96.7%), and the vital status was known for 4073 (99.9%) (Fig. S1 and Table S1 in the Supplementary Appendix).

D4_outcome_measurement.why: Independent end-point committee unaware of trial-group assignments.

witnesses.span: An independent clinical end-point committee, the members of which were unaware of the trial- group assignments, adjudicated all deaths, myo- cardial infarctions, strokes, hospitalizations for unstable angina or heart failure, and pancreatic events.

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: [revised after blind second read, RoB 2 5.1] Protocol amendment approved 30 July 2018 (before the 2021 results) defines the adjudicated MACE outcome. The paper's sentence that analyses followed prespecified plans finalised before unblinding is NOT bound here (a line break in the held PDF defeats the anchor), so D5 rests on the protocol alone -- weigh accordingly.

D2_treatment_discontinuation.note: stopped treatment -- recorded for D2 context; NOT missing outcome data
D2_treatment_discontinuation.why: exposure 88.9% vs 91.1% of follow-up time; followed to trial end regardless of adherence

witnesses.span: Unless consent was revoked, participants were followed until the end of the trial, regardless of adherence.
